core.nameFullTitle: The Rt Rev. the Lord Bishop of Hereford

interests.interest: Property in Oxfordshire from which rental income is received

synopsis: The Lord Bishop of Hereford's full title is The Rt Rev. the Lord Bishop of Hereford. His name is Richard Charles Jackson, and he is a current member of the House of Lords.

history.heading: Farms: Tenants
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what data they collect on the loss of tenanted agricultural holdings; and what the trend has been over the past decade.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

history.heading: Agriculture: Crime
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what estimate they have made of the annual cost of rural crime to agricultural businesses in England; and how those costs have changed since 2020.

history.heading: River Wye: Pollution Control
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what formal arrangements are in place between the UK and Welsh Governments for coordinating action on water quality in the River Wye catchment; how many meetings have been held under those arrangements in the past two years

history.heading: River Wye: Phosphorus
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what is their estimate of the change in annual phosphorus load entering the River Wye since 2020.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

history.heading: Farms: Profits
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what assessment they have made of trends in the profitability of tenant-farmed businesses compared with owner-occupied farm businesses over the past five years.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

history.heading: Housing: Rural Areas
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government how many homes have been delivered through rural exception sites in each of the past five years, by region.
history.answeringBodyName: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

history.heading: Community Development: Rural Areas
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what measures they use to assess social connectedness and civic participation in rural communities; and how those measures are reflected in decisions about funding community facilities and services.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport
